subject: AllyBridge x Redwood: Activation sprint & demo tour
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@allybridge.ai>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@allybridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: AllyBridge x Redwood: Activation sprint & demo tour

Hi Sophie / Marcus —

Thanks again for the call this week — excited by the overlap between our product roadmaps. I put together a short activation proposal that focuses on a lightweight, time-boxed run to build pipeline quickly:

- 60-minute co-hosted webinar (technical + use-case) aimed at engineers + product owners
- 2-week joint demo sprint to create 3 short demo videos for sales decks + blog assets
- Blog swap (guest post + short technical how-to) timed with the webinar
- Joint presence at CloudCon (co-branded booth + 20-min stage demo)

High-level asks from Redwood: a dedicated demo sandbox for the sprint, one product engineer for two half-days, shared registrant list for the webinar, and joint PR/announcement support.

Attached: RBW-allybridge-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan) and joint-demo-deck.pptx (starter deck).

Can you confirm interest and any timing constraints? Tentative dates we have in mind: webinar week of Jul 26–30 (prefer Jul 28), demo sprint Aug 2–13, CloudCon Sep 14–16. Happy to adjust to your calendar.

Next steps I propose: if you confirm interest, we lock webinar date and kick off a 30–45 minute scoping call with marketing and engineering next week.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RBW-allybridge-MAP-v1.xlsx, joint-demo-deck.pptx
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@allybridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@allybridge.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AllyBridge x Redwood: Activation sprint & demo tour

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. AllyBridge is very interested. High-level responses:

- Webinar: Jul 28 works well for our AM/EM time zones; we can co-sponsor and run live Q&A.
- Demo sprint: good to aim first two weeks of Aug; we can provide an engineer (Marcus) for the sprint and recorded clips.
- Blog swap: our content lead will draft a guest post (focus: inference at scale + cost tradeoffs).
- CloudCon: we confirmed availability for Sep 14–16; we can request an adjacent booth and propose a joint 20-minute stage slot.

I'll attach our capabilities one-pager and loop Marcus (logistics/field ops) into the thread to handle demo environment details and travel.

Sophie Tran
Head of Strategic Partnerships | AllyBridge
sophie.tran@allybridge.ai

Attachments: allybridge-capabilities-onepager.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AllyBridge x Redwood: Activation sprint & demo tour

Forwarding Sophie's note — quick operational checklist from infra/field perspective:  

- Demo sandbox: we need a staging VPC with sample dataset + API key provisioning. SRE estimate: 4–6 hours to stand up; can we provide access by Aug 2?
- Recording ops: does marketing want live recording or produced clips? If produced, add 1 week to delivery timeline.
- Travel/budget: co-branded booth at CloudCon will require a shared cost estimate. We should lock a preliminary travel budget and list of attendees by Aug 1.
- Registrant list & privacy: legal needs to review if we will share registrant PII. If AllyBridge can commit to hashed emails only, legal sign-off is faster.

Jordan / Marissa — can you confirm who will own each line item? I can follow up with SRE (cc: infra team) once owners are assigned.

Quoted message (Sophie):
> Jordan —
> 
> Appreciate the clear plan. AllyBridge is very interested. High-level responses: ...

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Field Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@allybridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@allybridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AllyBridge x Redwood: Activation sprint & demo tour

Jordan / Sophie —

Thanks — quick logistics note from my side: we can provide an engineer (Lina) for Aug 2–13 for the demo sprint and will share a draft demo script by Tue (linked below). We can also host a lightweight sandbox if Redwood prefers, but our preferred flow is to run the demos against AllyBridge staging and provide short recorded clips for co-branded assets.

I attached a proposed timeline (demo-sprint-timeline.csv) and a short live demo script outline. I'll create a shared folder for assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_allybridge-collab (shared).

Next items:
- Jordan: confirm whether Redwood needs the sandbox or AllyBridge-hosted staging (affects SRE work).
- Marissa: can your team lead production/recording and own the webinar registration flow?
- Karthik: will you confirm SRE availability for the Aug kickoff?

We want to keep this lightweight — goal is lead velocity in the next 6–8 weeks.

Marcus Reed
Head of Field Ops | AllyBridge
marcus.reed@allybridge.ai

Attachments: demo-sprint-timeline.csv
